field_type: positive int (bool refused), monotonic per record family

window_semantics.minimum: oldest schema version the writer still writes
window_semantics.current: newest schema version the writer knows
window_semantics.supports: minimum <= v <= current — anything below minimum and anything ABOVE current is refused

refuse_on_unknown_rule: 旧 CLI 遇新 schema 拒写 — a writer refuses a newer-than-known schema (error code schema_version_unsupported); it never guesses, never silently downgrades, never writes into a record it cannot fully interpret
bump_discipline: raising current = deliberate contract change; minimum moves forward only when old versions are genuinely retired; 新格式产生新数据后不得靠备份回退丢数据 (arch round-2 §规划缺失③)
